## Story

<div class="reader-page">

<div class="reader-text">

Storm is a black horse. Storm is the fastest horse on the farm. Storm loves to run. When he runs, his mane flies in the wind.

## Think About It

1. What is the horse's name? (Storm.) 2. What place does Storm come in? (Third.) 3. What lesson does Storm learn? (Running your best is what matters.)
